newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Turkish warships dock in north Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Turkish warships dock in north Cyprus.

text.p: Six Turkish warships and three submarines arrived in northern Cyprus on Monday on naval exercises, the Turkish Cypriot TAK news agency said.
Three gunboats and one submarine anchored at Kyrenia harbour, and three frigates and two submarines docked at the port of Famagusta. The flotilla is to depart on June 20, the agency said.

Cyprus has been divided since Turkey invaded in 1974 after a short-lived coup in Nicosia backed by the military junta then ruling Greece. A self-declared Turkish Cypriot state in the north is recognised only by Turkey.
